name: Refractive Rundown
description: LASIK, PRK, SMILE, ICL, RLE, presbyopia corrections, candidacy, topography, wavefront-guided, enhancements, and managing post-op optometry care.

episodes.title: LASIK: The Flap and the Laser
episodes.description: The microkeratome and femtosecond flap, the excimer ablation, and the patient experience from start to finish.

episodes.title: PRK: The Surface Ablation Alternative
episodes.description: The epithelial removal, the ablation, the bandage lens, and the longer recovery and pain.

episodes.title: SMILE: The Lenticule Extraction Revolution
episodes.description: The small incision, the lenticule, the flapless advantage, and the limitations and learning curve.

episodes.title: LASIK Candidacy: Who Qualifies and Who Does Not
episodes.description: The refractive stability, the pachymetry floor, the topography screen, and the DED exclusion.

episodes.title: Topography and Tomography in Refractive Screening
episodes.description: Detecting the forme fruste keratoconus that disqualifies and the elevation data that catches what axial misses.

episodes.title: Wavefront-Guided Versus Topography-Guided LASIK
episodes.description: The higher-order aberration data, the customized ablation, and when each approach wins.

episodes.title: PresbyLASIK: The Presbyopia Correction Attempt
episodes.description: The monovision and multifocal ablation strategies and the compromise that each demands.

episodes.title: Phakic IOLs: The ICL for High Myopia
episodes.description: The implantable collamer lens, the anterior chamber depth requirement, and the vault and safety monitoring.

episodes.title: Refractive Lens Exchange: The Cataract Before the Cataract
episodes.description: When RLE beats corneal surgery, the IOL options, and the retinal risk counseling for high myopes.

episodes.title: Presbyopia-Correcting IOLs: The Multifocal and EDOF Spectrum
episodes.description: The diffractive, refractive, and extended depth of focus designs and the visual trade-offs of each.

episodes.title: Toric IOLs: The Astigmatism Correction at the Lens Plane
episodes.description: The calculation, the axis marking, the post-op rotation, and the enhancement decision.

episodes.title: Corneal Relaxing Incisions: The LRIs and the Astigmatism
episodes.description: The manual and femtosecond LRIs, the coupling ratio, and the timing relative to cataract surgery.

episodes.title: Post-LASIK Optometry Care: The Day 1, Week 1, Month 1 Protocol
episodes.description: The flap check, the steroid and antibiotic taper, and the dry eye and regression management.

episodes.title: LASIK Flap Complications: Striae, Dislocation, and DLK
episodes.description: The flap striae detection, the diffuse lamellar keratitis stages, and the urgent flap lift and irrigation.

episodes.title: Post-PRK Care: The Epithelial Healing and the Haze
episodes.description: The bandage lens timeline, the mitomycin C decision, and the subepithelial haze that follows UV exposure.
